### Game title

GTA V

### Game ID / serial

PPSA04263

### KytyPS5 version

KytyPS5-2026-10-22-f5f4e7d

### Compatibility status

In game

### Last working build / first broken build

_No response_

### Result details

The game is running better and better !
Cinematics are running at 60 fps with some tiny freezes
Game is running around 25 fps on average (from 20 to 60fps) with far far less freezes than before.
That's a great job !

The game's finally crashing after around 10 minutes of roaming in the city.

The game is also still crashing just before the prologue scene as before without using a save game file.


### Steps to reproduce the result

Boot
Play

### Expected behavior

Smoother
No freeze
No crashes

### OS

Windows 11 Pro 25H2

### CPU

AMD Ryzen 9800X3D

### GPU

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080

### RAM / VRAM

32 GB DDR5 RAM / 16 GB VRAM
